france-unrest-2026: Expensive fuel turned a school protest into nationwide anger, and that anger now moves France's borrowing costs, its next election and its neighbours.
gulf-war-energy-shock: One war is pushing up what the world pays for fuel, and that ripples into protests, interest rates, elections and famine relief on four continents.
france-debt-stress: Riots and rising rates make lenders nervous about France, and what France pays to borrow could shape its election and spill over to Italy.
france-election-2027: Riots, debt and new EU rules are shaping France's April vote, and its winner could decide France's support for Ukraine and the EU's next budget.
italy-cost-of-living-riots: Fuel prices and costlier borrowing fed Italy's riots, and the disorder now feeds into its 2027 election.
italy-election-2027: Italy's riots are shaping its 2027 vote, and the winner decides whether Rome keeps backing Ukraine.
belgium-cost-of-living-clashes: Belgian students copied France's school blockades, and the protests turned into clashes in Brussels and Liege.
portugal-housing-protests: Rents rising faster than wages pushed Portugal's unions onto the streets, the same squeeze behind France's protests.
spain-strike-and-snap-election: Housing and wage anger drives Spain's November strike, and its snap election puts a deadline on the EU's budget talks.
ukraine-summit-diplomacy: Elections in France, Italy and the US, Russia's money troubles and a Trump-Xi summit all shape any deal on Ukraine.
eu-budget-2028-2034: Europe is racing to agree its next budget before elections, and that budget decides how much it can give Ukraine after 2027.
ecb-inflation-and-rates: War-driven energy prices keep European inflation high, so the ECB cannot help France without fighting itself.
eu-supply-chain-rules-2027: New EU import rules hit Chinese steel, Turkish castings and Brazilian soy, and their costs land on French farmers months before France votes.
alberta-independence-vote: High oil prices and US tariffs fed Alberta's independence campaign, though 77% voted to stay in Canada.
china-q3-growth: China's growth rides on exports, which US trade rules, a Trump summit and oil prices can lift or squeeze, and which now meet Europe's carbon charge.
istanbul-floods: Floods in Istanbul add delays for Turkish suppliers to European factories just as new EU carbon paperwork begins.
us-midterms-2026: Fuel prices and tariffs are driving America's 3 November vote, and the result could limit Trump's hand on Ukraine.
brazil-runoff-2026: Brazil's 25 October vote decides how its soy, beef and coffee meet Europe's new deforestation rule.
us-canada-trade-war: US tariffs on Canada raise American prices before the midterms and sharpen Alberta's grievances with Ottawa.
usmca-annual-review-2027: America's yearly review of its North American trade pact is a lever on Canada and Mexico, and a wall against Chinese goods.
venezuela-oil-reopening: With Gulf oil disrupted, Venezuela's crude is being rushed to US refineries, and Trump is selling it as cheaper fuel before the vote.
apec-shenzhen-2026: Trump's trip to meet Xi in Shenzhen could move China's exports, North Korea's missiles, a Ukraine deal and the South China Sea.
boj-october-decision-2026: Expensive Gulf oil pushes Japan's inflation, and higher Japanese rates can pull money out of French bonds.
india-us-trade-deal-2026: India's trade deal with the US runs through Russian oil, which the Gulf war makes hard to give up.
north-korea-missile-tests-2026: Trump's talk of meeting Kim turned North Korea's missile tests into bargaining chips before the Shenzhen summit.
south-china-sea-incidents-2026: Clashes at sea test whether China behaves differently while it prepares to host Trump.
sudan-darfur-kordofan-famine-alert: War, drought and costlier shipping from the Iran war are pushing Sudan's famine further than aid can reach.
ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears: A new war between Ethiopia and Eritrea would pull aid away from Sudan's famine and add risk to a key shipping lane.
israel-election-2026: Israel's vote is a referendum on the Iran war, and its result decides how much Gulf oil can come back.
opec-plus-november-output-hold: The war, not choice, is holding back Gulf oil, which keeps prices high for Europe, China and Russia's budget.
russia-record-budget-deficit-2026: Sanctions and oil prices left Russia's budget hole twice the plan, raising its interest in a Ukraine deal.
serbia-student-election-2026: Student street protests against 12 years of Vučić rule feed this snap election, whose result will shape Serbia's EU accession path and Russia alignment.
ebola-drc-nigeria-kenya-2026: A DR Congo Ebola outbreak now in Nigeria and Kenya, with patients possibly meeting at Uganda's airport, pressures airport screening and travel rules.
west-bank-lockdown-hebron-2026: The shooting of two Israeli soldiers feeds Israel's West Bank closure and Hebron demolitions, which in turn shape campaign security politics before the 27 October vote.
rubio-cia-cuba-appeal-2026: US pressure on adversaries in the region feeds Rubio's call for Cubans to partner with the CIA, which raises pressure on Havana.
ukraine-starlink-restrictions-2026: US-controlled Starlink access, which Ukraine's military relies on for communications, feeds the same US support for Kyiv's war effort that shapes the Putin-Trump-Xi summit push.
burnham-eu-free-movement-talks-2026: Burnham's call for talks on EU free movement, backed by Rayner, could reshape UK-EU migration, labour flows and ties with member states if pursued.
